name: Hearthstone Firearms Guardian-12 'Bedside'
description:
The Hearthstone Guardian-12 is a double-action semi-automatic pistol chambered in .380 ACP, designed and marketed specifically for home defense in Shelf and lower-Mid residential blocks. The frame is oversized for the caliber, making it easy to grip with shaking or untrained hands. The trigger pull in double-action mode is deliberately heavy at 5.5kg to prevent negligent discharge.

The Guardian-12 ships with a built-in trigger lock, a loaded chamber indicator visible in darkness through a tritium-painted port, and an instruction manual written at a fourth-grade reading level in fourteen languages. Hearthstone designed every aspect of this weapon for people who have never held a gun before and hope they never have to fire one. The heavy trigger, the visible chamber indicator, the oversized grip — all of it prioritizes safety over performance.

The Bedside is the best-selling firearm in Shelf residential districts. Families keep them in nightstand drawers and kitchen cabinets, loaded with hollow-point rounds that Hearthstone bundles in the box. It is not a weapon for professionals. It is a weapon for parents who heard gunshots last night and decided they needed something between themselves and the door.
specifications:
caliber: .380 ACP
effective_range: 12 meters
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic (double-action)
magazine_capacity: 10 rounds
weight: 0.62 kg
tactical_use: A home defense weapon designed for untrained users at close range. The heavy trigger and low-powered caliber reduce the risk of negligent discharge and over-penetration through residential walls. Effective only against unarmored targets at room distance. Not suitable for any tactical application requiring speed, accuracy, or stopping power against determined attackers.
cultural_context: The Guardian-12 represents the quiet fear that runs through Shelf residential life. Families don't talk about having one, but surveys suggest nearly one in three Shelf households contains a Bedside. It is a weapon born from resignation — the understanding that no one is coming to help if something happens at three in the morning.
story_hooks: A child fires a Guardian-12 during a break-in and kills an intruder who turns out to be a corponation employee on a sanctioned operation. The legal fallout threatens to consume an entire Shelf block.
Hearthstone is offering a trade-in program for Guardian-12s — but the traded weapons aren't being destroyed. They're being shipped somewhere.

physical_description.visual_profile: A distinctly civilian-oriented compact pistol with generous proportions—bulbous, almost comforting in its roundness. The frame is noticeably oversized relative to its .380 caliber, creating a squat, approachable silhouette that reads 'safe' rather than 'lethal.' No aggressive angles; every surface curves inward as if designed to fit trembling hands.
physical_description.dimensions: Overall length 160mm, slide width 32mm, grip height 105mm, barrel length 85mm
physical_description.weight_description: Light but dense; 620 grams feels reassuring rather than substantial—a gentle heft that suggests control without intimidation
physical_description.primary_material: Polymer frame (matte finished reinforced polycarbonate) with steel slide
physical_description.finish: Matte charcoal-gray polymer body with brushed stainless steel slide; intentionally unmarked and subdued to avoid drawing attention
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray and matte black; neutral, domestic aesthetic—the color palette of a household appliance
physical_description.grip_texture: Deeply textured rubber grip with horizontal grooves; soft-touch material designed for sweaty or unsteady hands
distinctive_features: Visible tritium-painted chamber indicator port on left side of slide (faintly glowing green in darkness)
Heavy external hammer with serrated striking surface (telegraphs firing intent visually)
Loaded chamber indicator—a small pin that protrudes when round is chambered
Integrated trigger lock mechanism with minimal visual footprint
Rounded edges throughout; no sharp corners or snag points
Fourth-grade friendly instruction molded into grip in raised text
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: HEARTHSTONE FIREARMS logo and GUARDIAN-12 designation stamped on left side of slide in sans-serif font; serial number on frame; minimal branding overall—understated corporate restraint
physical_description.condition_typical: Mint to lightly used; nightstand wear (light dust, occasional fingerprints, possible fade from bedside lamp light). Users maintain these religiously due to safety-conscious ownership culture; negligible field damage
